 Oral Order

The instant revision is admitted for hearing.
2.
The petitioner was convicted for committing offence under Section 376/504/506/34 of the IPC in GR Case No. 52 of 2019 arising out of Azamnagar P.S. Case No. 04 of 2019.
He was sentenced to be detained in special home for a period of 24 months under Section 18(1)(g) of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The order of conviction and sentence was challenged by the petitioner in Criminal Appeal No. 09 of 2024.
The said appeal was also dismissed affirming the order of conviction and sentence against the juvenile.
Considering the order of conviction passed by the trial court and affirmed by the appellate court in heinous- offense, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
The prayer for bail is thus rejected.
Patna High Court CR. REV. No.865 of 2024(2) dt.10-04-2025 3.
Since, the petitioner is detained in special home, the instant revision be listed for hearing on 29th April 2025.

(Bibek Chaudhuri, J) Suraj Dubey/-

opennyai_summary.decision:
The order of conviction and sentence was challenged by the petitioner in Criminal Appeal No. 09 of 2024.
Considering the order of conviction passed by the trial court and affirmed by the appellate court in heinous- offense, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
The prayer for bail is thus rejected.
Since, the petitioner is detained in special home, the instant revision be listed for hearing on 29th April 2025.
